title: Roof Replacement in Troutdale, OR
summary: In June 2025, French Roofing replaced the shingle roof on a home in Troutdale, OR. The crew tore the old gray shingles off down to the deck, laid new synthetic underlayment, and installed brown CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles with new ridge cap, roof vents and pipe flashings.
scope: Tore off the old shingles down to the roof deck
Installed APOC Weather-Armor Cross Over synthetic underlayment
Installed new CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles
Capped the ridges and hips with new ridge cap shingles
New roof vents and new flashing boots around the plumbing vent pipes

faqs.question: What shingles went on this Troutdale roof?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark architectural shingles in a brown blend, over APOC Weather-Armor Cross Over synthetic underlayment, with new ridge cap on the ridges and hips.
